MemoService is served over two protocols. I am identifying the specific protocol names and their corresponding file paths.

gRPC-Gateway is registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. Connect is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` and wrapped in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.

Generated gRPC-Gateway registration lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`. Generated Connect handler code lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.
Checking for a native gRPC server registration in addition to Connect and gRPC-Gateway.

Identifying the two protocols served by MemoService.

gRPC-Gateway is registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. Connect is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` and wrapped in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.

The gRPC-Gateway registration is in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. The APIV1Service directly implements the gRPC server interface, so no separate wrapping file exists for that protocol.

MCP is not a serving protocol for MemoService. It wraps OpenAPI operations from the gRPC-Gateway generated spec.

The two serving protocols are Connect and gRPC-Gateway.

- Connect — registration in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`, wrapping in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`
- gRPC-Gateway — registration in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`

There is no separate wrapping file for gRPC-Gateway; the service implements the interface directly.

gRPC-Gateway — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`

MemoService is exposed over Connect and gRPC-Gateway. Both are wired up in `RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (see the comment at line 64).

For **Connect**, registration is in `connect_handler.go` via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler` inside `RegisterConnectHandlers` (line 40). Method wrapping is in `connect_services.go`, where `ConnectServiceHandler` delegates MemoService RPCs to the underlying `APIV1Service` (starting at line 304).

For **gRPC-Gateway**, registration is in `v1.go` via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` (line 108). There is no separate wrapper; `APIV1Service` implements the gRPC service interface directly and is mounted on `/api/v1/*`.
